subject: Initial demo intake — CloudPath discovery & procurement items
messages:
From: Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@cloudpath.io>
To: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@cloudpath.io>; marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro + request to schedule initial discovery

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the quick responses on the intake form — CloudPath is excited to evaluate Redwood for a pilot. We'd like to set an initial discovery to align on objectives, scope, and procurement timelines. The core stakeholders who should join: our engineering lead (Daniel Cho), procurement ops (procure@cloudpath.io), and our security reviewer (I'll loop if we progress).

High-level goals for the 45m call:
- Share CloudPath's primary use cases and SLAs needed
- Walk through model options / hosted vs. private considerations
- Procurement timeline & contract questions (we're aiming to start a pilot in June)

Our availability next week (PST):
- Wed 5/17: 10:00–11:30 or 15:00–16:30
- Thu 5/18: 09:00–11:00

If you want an SE on the call, please include them — we can also surface a security questionnaire if that helps.

Thanks,
Nadia Ortiz
Head of Product Partnerships | CloudPath
attachments: intake-form-CP.pdf (application/pdf)
From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
To: Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@cloudpath.io>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, soojin_lee@redwood.ai, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@cloudpath.io>, Procurement Ops <procure@cloudpath.io>
Date: Tue, 15 May 2028 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule initial discovery

Hi Nadia — great to meet you (virtually). Marissa is the AE on this account and will help with commercial/timeline questions; I've copied Soojin (SE) to handle technical scope and security touchpoints.

We can do a 45m discovery. Proposed slots (PST):
- Wed 5/17 10:00–10:45 (works for SE)
- Thu 5/18 09:30–10:15

If those don't work, send a few times and we'll adapt. To make the call efficient, I'm attaching a short demo checklist and a checklist .xlsx with suggested pre-read items (network ports, data residency notes, and SOC2 question pointers). If procurement prefers a separate contract sync, we can schedule that immediately after the discovery.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference — Developer-first inference platform
attachments: Redwood-demo-checklist.pdf (application/pdf), pre-demo-security-items.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Ortiz <nadia.ortiz@cloudpath.io>, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@cloudpath.io>
Date: Wed, 16 May 2028 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + request to schedule initial discovery

Thanks — adding a couple of technical notes so the discovery can be actionable:  

- Would be helpful if Daniel can share the primary inference workload (average prompts/sec, typical seq lengths, and any PII patterns). Even ballpark numbers help with model and capacity recommendations.
- If CloudPath expects on-prem or VPC-hosted instances, please flag that so I can prepare the deployment/ops slide.
- For security/compliance: I can attach a short "pre-demo security checklist" that maps to SOC2 and data residency items. If procurement wants evidence, we can kick off an evidence package request during the call.

My availability (PST): Thu 5/18 09:30–11:00 or Fri 5/19 13:00–15:00. I can make 5/17 morning only if forced, but preference is 5/18 so I can prep demo artifacts.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
attachments: security-questionnaire-response.xlsx (stub)

Thanks — quick update from our side: procurement prefers to review high-level commercial terms before the discovery so they can confirm the pilot window. Can we do a 15m procurement sync right after the discovery (same invite, optional for Eng)? Also, we do need SOC 2 Type II evidence and details on data retention policies.

Prefered slot: Thu 5/18 09:30–10:15 PST works best for our engineering lead and procurement. If that slot is locked, Wed morning is the backup.

Daniel Cho
Engineering Lead | CloudPath

Perfect — locking Thu 5/18 09:30–10:15 PST for the discovery + 15m procurement hangover (will keep it optional for Eng). Calendar invite attached. Agenda below:

45m discovery (09:30–10:15) - Introductions & success criteria (10m) - Workload & integration constraints (15m, Soojin lead) - Deployment options & security overview (10m, Soojin) - Pilot timeline & procurement questions (10m, Marissa/Rishi)

15m procurement follow-up (10:15–10:30) - High-level terms and next steps (Marissa)

Pre-read / attachments: Redwood-demo-checklist.pdf; security-questionnaire-response.xlsx. HubSpot deal updated: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/49823/rdw-2028-3491

If procurement needs an expedited redline, loop Sean (copied) and he'll coordinate legal support.

Thanks everyone — invite sent (calendar-invite-CP-initial.ics).

See you Thursday,
Rishi Malhotra
